newsitem.title: USA: BASF AG's Knoll to fight thyroid lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: BASF AG's Knoll to fight thyroid lawsuit.

text.p: Knoll Pharmaceutical Co said Monday a lawsuit accusing it of suprressing a medical study to control the U.S. market for thyroid drugs is unfounded.

Knoll said in a statement Monday evening that there are "significant flaws" in the 1990 study it is accused of suppressing, which concluded that the Synthroid drug sold by Knoll was no more effective than less expensive drugs.
"The allegations in the lawsuit are completely unfounded and Knoll intends to defend this litigation vigorously," the company statement said.
The $8.5 billion lawsuit was filed in U.S. District Court in San Francisco last week against Germany's BASF AG and its U.S. unit, Knoll.
Attorney Barry Himmelstein, who represents the thyroid patients for whom the suit was filed, has said he would seek class action status for the suit and a jury trial in San Francisco.
